android.desc: FarmVille 3 - Farm Animals is a mobile farming simulation game where players build and customize a thriving farm, collect and breed hundreds of unique animal species, and craft goods to fulfill orders and grow their village. It combines relaxing farm life gameplay with deep animal collection mechanics, creative decoration, and social features making it a top choice for fans of farming games on mobile. What kind of game is FarmVille 3 ? FarmVille 3 is a farm simulation game where players raise animals, harvest crops, craft artisan goods, and fulfill orders to expand their farm from a small homestead into a thriving village with relaxing gameplay and long-term daily progression. FEATURES OF FARMVILLE 3 🐣 Animal Collection and Breeding The heart of FarmVille 3 is its animal collection system. Players unlock, raise, and breed hundreds of animals across dozens of species, from classic farm animals like chickens, cows, pigs, and horses to exotic and specialty breeds like penguins, alpacas, and rare hybrids. • Breed animals to discover new, rare species • Each animal produces unique farm goods • Rare breeds yield premium resources that unlock advanced crafting recipes and progression • Complete mini-games and special events to rescue and unlock exotic animals • Build and upgrade animal habitats tailored to each species • Raise baby animals by feeding them and completing nurturing quests 🏡 Farm Decoration and Building Design Your Dream Farm Full creative control over how their farm looks and grows: • Design and decorate your farm with hundreds of unique buildings, structures, and ornamental items • Choose from multiple building styles, skins, and seasonal themes • Customize farmhands and pets with outfits and accessories • Expand your land by unlocking new zones, from the garden to the forest and beyond • Renovate and upgrade animal habitats, crafting buildings, and community structures • Use weather mechanics to optimize harvest timing for crops like hay, wheat, and specialty produce • Transform a small plot into a fully personalized village, the layout, style, and pace are entirely up to you Crafting and Fulfilling Orders • Craft artisan goods: cook recipes, bake bread, press oil, produce dairy, brew beverages, and more • Fulfill sale orders from villagers and traders to earn coins, experience, and expansion materials • Work with local artisans including blacksmiths, cooks,
